signings.note: Both signatures changed to carry a distinction the old ones could not. `body` returns the `Published` newtype so a caller cannot hand back an unpublished string, and `sweep_repo` returns `Swept::{Measured, Skipped}` so a sweep that examined nothing stops reading as a clean one. Every caller moves in the same change; anvil is not a published library, so no consumer exists outside this tree. Both entries go inert once this merges, because the gate reads a diff and the diff will no longer carry them.
